entities.name: sl-QuantityConfig
entities.description: Sidelink quantity configuration parameters received by the UE that configure measurement quantities for sidelink operations.

entities.name: VarMeasConfigSL
entities.description: UE variable storing the sidelink measurement configuration including sl-QuantityConfig parameters and sl-MeasIdList.

entities.name: sl-MeasId
entities.description: Identifier for a sidelink measurement configuration entry in the sl-MeasIdList.

entities.name: sl-MeasIdList
entities.description: List of sidelink measurement identifiers configured in VarMeasConfigSL.

entities.name: VarMeasReportListSL
entities.description: UE variable storing active sidelink measurement reporting entries.

entities.name: periodical reporting timer
entities.description: Timer controlling periodic reporting for sidelink measurements.

entities.name: sl-TimeToTrigger
entities.description: Time-to-trigger parameter associated with sidelink measurement reporting.

relations.description: Received sl-QuantityConfig parameters are stored in VarMeasConfigSL.
Measurement reporting entry for sl-MeasId is removed from VarMeasReportListSL.
Periodical reporting timer is stopped for the sl-MeasId.
Associated information like sl-TimeToTrigger is reset for the sl-MeasId.
